primaryRawText:
GX BRONZE 450
MPX-4501-ACAAB
STABLE, ABLE POWER WITH SLEEVED CABLES
The GX Bronze offers the stability and reliability of a high-
end PSU without a huge jump in price from entry level
offerings. The 80 Plus Bronze rated efficiency, high quality
components, and 5 year warranty offer a power supply
that’s great for PC builders both beginning and advanced.
The GX Bronze is ErP 2013 lot 6 compliant, making it
environmentally friendly and better for your electric bill. The
sleeved cables reduce clutter and increase airflow. The
Silencio fan and sealed LDB bearings ensure quiet cooling.
Everything about the GX Bronze was made with your
practical needs in mind.
FEATURES SPECIFICATIONS
80 Plus Bronze Certified : This certification guarantees a typical
efficiency of 85% under normal operating conditions.
Sealed LDB Fan Bearings : The sealed LDB bearings have been
combined with Silencio fan technology for quiet cooling with a
longer lifespan.
DC-DC Circuit Design : The DC-DC circuit design offers you reliable
and stable output voltages offering consistent power delivery at
40°C.
Quality Capacitors : High quality capacitors for increased lifetime
and temperature resistance.
Sleeved Cables : Sleeved cables reduce clutter, improve cable
management, and add an additional layer of protection to the
cables.
5 Year Warranty : This unit comes with a standard limited
manufacturing warranty of 5 years from the date of purchase.

 FEATURES
80 Plus Bronze certification ensure a
typical efficiency of 85%
The DC-DC design keeps voltages stable.
As a result, this power supply unit is fully
capable of supporting Intel’s C6/C7 low-
power states.
The sealed LDB bearings have been
combined with Silencio fan technology
for quiet cooling with a longer lifespan.
ErP 2013 Lot 6 compliance ensure less
than 0.5 Watt used in standby mode.
Dual Forward topology and DC-DC design
work together to produce stable voltages
and higher efficiency.
Sleeved cables reduce clutter,
improve cable management, and
add an additional layer of protection
to the cables.
